# `prefer-buffered-writer`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports writes through a directly obtained unbuffered writer inside a loop.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Repeated small writes can turn one logical operation into many syscalls.

## When it fires

The writer must be locally bound from `.writer()` or stdout. Writer parameters
are ignored because their caller may already buffer them.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

fn dump(dir: std.fs.Dir, values: []const u8) !void {
    const file = try dir.createFile("out.txt", .{});
    const writer = file.writer();
    for (values) |value| {
        try writer.print("{d}\n", .{value});
    }
}
```
